name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Erasmus+ programme for the period 2028-2034, and repealing Regulations (EU) 2021/817 and (EU) 2021/888
part_text: ANNEX INDICATORS The measurements of quantitative indicators shall be disaggregated, where appropriate, in accordance with data protection rules according to country, gender and type of action and activity. 1. Areas to be monitored - Participation in learning mobility and volunteering; - Organisations and institutions with a reinforced European and international dimension. 2. Elements to be measured (a) Learning mobility and volunteering: - The number of participants in learning mobility; - The number of participants in volunteering and solidarity activities; - The number of organisations and institutions taking part in the Programme’s actions under Articles 4, 4a and 4b; - The number of participants in virtual learning activities; - The share of participants that consider they have benefited from their participation in learning mobility and volunteering activities; - The share of participants that consider they have an increased European sense of belonging after their participation in learning mobility and volunteering activities; (b) Cooperation among organisations and institutions: - The number of organisations and institutions taking part in the Programme’s actions under Article 6; - The share of organisations and institutions that consider they have developed high-quality practices as a result of their participation in the Programme’s actions under Article 6; (c) Support to policy development: - The number of organisations and institutions taking part in grant actions under Article 7; (d) Synergies: - The share of actions funded from additional resources as referred to in Article 10 or a Union contribution from another programme as referred to in Article 11; (e) Inclusion: - The number of people with fewer opportunities taking part in learning mobility and volunteering activities; - The number of newcomer organisations and institutions taking part in the Programme; (f) Simplification: - The number of small-scale partnerships supported under Article 6; - The share of organisations and institutions that consider that the procedures for taking part in the Programme are proportionate and simple; (g) Climate contribution: - The share of learning mobility and volunteering activities addressing climate objectives; - The share of projects under Article 6 addressing climate objectives; - The number of participants in learning mobility and volunteering choosing sustainable travel means.
